title: docs(audit): document the 3-manifest-edit checklist for adding a new lite instruction file
body:
## Background

Adding a new lite instruction file under
`idd-template/.github/instructions/lite/` requires editing
`audit/sync-manifest.json` in **three** separate places for
`node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` to pass:

1. A `syncPairs` entry (source/target mode) — this is what
   `sync-docs.mjs` actually reads to generate the mirrored
   `.github/instructions/lite/*.instructions.md` copy.
2. A `bundleBudgets` entry — the byte ceiling for the lite file's own
   phase bundle (e.g. `bundle-review-snapshot-lite`).
3. The file's path added to `generatedBlocks[0].paths` (the
   `idd-template-core-files` block) — required only because
   `audit-docs.mjs --check` compares the rendered
   `idd-template/ONBOARDING.md` file-listing block against this list,
   even though the block plays no role in generating the mirror
   itself.

`audit/README.md` (the manifest's own documentation) explains each of
`syncPairs`, `bundleBudgets`, and `generatedBlocks` individually, but
never states that authoring a single new lite file touches all three.
Worse, `docs/weak-model-lite-profile-design.md`'s own note on this
(added while decomposing roadmap #1539) reads: "`sync-docs.mjs` also
reads `generatedBlocks` / `shellFileLists` for its separate
consolidated-reference-block generation ... but that path is not
relevant here" — true for *generation*, but silently wrong for what
`audit-docs.mjs --check` actually enforces, since the same
`generatedBlocks[0].paths` list is checked, not just used for
generation.

This bit issue #1617's own subagent directly: after adding
`syncPairs` and `bundleBudgets` entries for
`idd-review-snapshot-lite.instructions.md`, `audit-docs.mjs --check`
still failed until the `generatedBlocks[0].paths` list was also
updated — a step nowhere documented as required. #1548 (closed, PR
#1606) documents the lite-profile *opt-in* convention for a running
session; it does not cover this *authoring-time* manifest checklist,
so it does not already close this gap. Confirmed unfiled via
`gh search issues` for `"generatedBlocks"`, `"sync-manifest
checklist"`, and `"sync-manifest paths"`.

## Proposed change

Document the three-part checklist in `audit/README.md`'s existing
"Intentional Exceptions" section (the natural home, since it already
covers the "For generated file lists, update the manifest paths or
globs first" case): spell out that adding a new file under an
existing `generatedBlocks[].sourceGlobs` match (such as a new lite
instruction file) requires (1) a `syncPairs` entry, (2) a
`bundleBudgets` entry when the file participates in a phase bundle,
and (3) adding the file's path to the relevant
`generatedBlocks[].paths` list, and that step 3 is required for the
audit to pass even though it is unrelated to `sync-docs.mjs`
generation.

Correct `docs/weak-model-lite-profile-design.md`'s existing note so
it no longer reads as "`generatedBlocks` is not relevant here" without
qualification — add a short clause distinguishing "not relevant to
generation" from "still required for `audit-docs.mjs --check`."

This is a documentation-only change: no script, schema, or manifest
behavior changes, only correcting/completing existing prose.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `audit/README.md`'s "Intentional Exceptions" section states the
      three manifest edits required to add a new file under an
      existing `generatedBlocks[].sourceGlobs` pattern (e.g. a new
      lite instruction file): `syncPairs`, `bundleBudgets` (when
      applicable), and `generatedBlocks[].paths`.
- [ ] `docs/weak-model-lite-profile-design.md`'s note on
      `generatedBlocks` no longer implies the block is irrelevant to
      `audit-docs.mjs --check`, only to `sync-docs.mjs` generation.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.

---

_Autopilot suitability: 4 / 5 -- higher is more autopilot-suitable; below the configured floor is human-oriented._

_Effort: S -- author-estimated size; a soft autopilot selection tie-breaker only._
